description: This file defines an abstract controller class for managing the Search Framework's UI MVC component in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for handling requests, displaying views, redirection, AJAX detection, and JSON responses.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: An abstract controller class for managing search UI requests, handling display, redirection, AJAX detection, and JSON output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a view object.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, directing to specific actions or default display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Triggers the view's preDisplay and display methods.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect to the specified location.

methods.name: isAjax
methods.description: Checks if the current request is an AJAX request.

methods.name: yieldJson
methods.description: Outputs JSON data with correct headers, handling encoding errors gracefully.

methods.name: isActionRequest
methods.description: Determines if the current request corresponds to an action method.

methods.name: getActionName
methods.description: Retrieves and sanitizes the action name from input parameters.
